top_line: KPMG has made a section 30 referral to the health and social care secretary over Nottingham University Hospitals Trust's breach of its breakeven duty, reporting four significant value-for-money weaknesses and finding the trust "lacks the capability to deliver expected performance without external support" as it carries an £80.6m 2025/26 deficit, a £106m savings target risk-adjusted at £64.8m and a corridor care elimination pledge already behind trajectory.
